title: studio: the Automations and App creates can write a blank draft over a published flow or app of the same identifier (first-write pin is draft-only)
body:
## Source

Found by the #26836 card thread (PR #26916, out-of-scope finding), checked by the ui seat on `origin/main` `94e29cd1`. Not reproduced end to end yet: the mechanism is #26836's, read from the code.

## Problem

Studio's creates save the blank skeleton with `{ mode: 'draft', ifNoneMatch: '*' }`. The door's first-write pin is lifecycle-scoped (`SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.parentVersion: null` means "no current row of this lifecycle"), so it refuses only where a DRAFT row exists. Over a PUBLISHED row of the same identifier it writes the skeleton as that item's pending draft, and a package publish then replaces the live item with the blank one. #26836 measured this for permission sets; PR #26916 fixes Access by reading published and draft rows before the save, as the Interfaces create already does (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ~4225).

The same pin, with no published-row read, remains in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`:
- `doCreateFlow` (~7452, save ~7481): no taken-identifier check at all.
- `doCreateApp` (~1680, save ~1694): no taken-identifier check.
- `doCreateObject` (~5976, save ~5992): checks only the objects on its own rail (`objects.some`), not published or draft rows elsewhere. The namespace prefix makes a cross-package clash less likely, not impossible.

## Target

Measure each create first: name a published flow, app and object, create one with the same identifier, and check whether a draft lands over it. For each create that does, read the published rows and the drafts of that type before the save (the Interfaces/Access shape), refuse a taken identifier in the dialog naming the holder, and keep the first-write pin for the race. Report any create that is already safe.

## File surface

`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the three create callbacks and their dialogs), studio namespace `en.ts`/`zh.ts` for the refusal sentences, tests beside, one root changeset. No `packages/spec/**`, no server change: the pin's lifecycle scope is the declared contract (the #26836 thread's open question, answered A by the ui seat).

## Acceptance

For each affected create, an identifier held by a published item of that type is refused before anything is written, and the published item's body is unchanged. A fresh identifier creates as before.

Related: #26836, PR #26916, objectui#11773.
